notes.title: Update 1.85 - Fog of War missions
notes.notes: The new update adds the possibility to play (or re-play) all solo campaign challenges under fog of war. Simply select the "fog of war" button once you enter "missions" or "battles" sub-menus. Another new feature is the record of the amount of turns in which each challenge was solved (or each battle won). Work on your efficiency and see if you can win a certain mission or battle in a shorter time!

notes.title: What version 1.81 brought
notes.notes:
* 10 new missions/challenges available in the solo campaign mode.

As before, they are all played in no-luck mode, so there is no randomness during fights and only your tactical skills and strategic thinking will matter!

* bugfix for no-survivors mode

* rollback of OpenAL audio drivers


50% DISCOUNT DEAL will end April 11. Spread the word with your friends and let more people enjoy (and deliver) Retaliation :)

notes.title: Update 1.78 - New Single Player Campaign and Missions
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the new update 1.78.
This new update adds a new Single Player Campaign to Retaliation Enemy Mine. 

We added a new Game Mode with 20 Missions ( to start, more will follow ).

The Missions are challenges, to be played in No-Luck mode (no randomness). Find the best way to solve each mission, carefully planning your moves and attacks.

A new  Battles Menu is in development!

notes.title: Update 1.74 - Multiplayer Android free
notes.notes:
We are pleased to announce the new update 1.74.
This new update added the ability to connect with a Retaliation Enemy Mine Android Free devices on multiplayer matches.

HOWTO: 

1) install Enemy Mine on your android device ([url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.xteamsoftware.retaliationenemyminefree]google play link[/url])

2) go to MULTIPLAYER > SETUP

3) enter in USER and PASSWORD fields the same credentials you use on your steam desktop Enemy Mine

4) Enjoy playing on the go

notes.title: Retaliation: Slack community
notes.notes:
TL;DR: We have created a slack community for all players of Retaliation. Send email to receive invitation.

To all (current or future) players of Retaliation: you are welcome to join our [b]slack community[/b].

You can use it to get [b]realtime online support[/b], to [b]discuss[/b] the game strategy or to meet other players and [b]setup online matches[/b].

What is slack? [i]An online communication and collaboration platform, with persistent chat rooms (channels) organized by topic, as well as direct messaging.

It's very lightweight and works perfectly also inside a browser, without need to install anything, or through use of its dedicated apps, available for all desktop and mobile platforms.[/i]

To join, send an email to "[b]info AT OURDOMAIN[/b]" and you'll receive the invitation link (slack works that way).

[i]Note: substitute "[b] AT OURDOMAIN[/b]" above with "[b]@retaliationgame.com[/b]" to complete the address...[/i]

notes.title: Full Version Now Available!
notes.notes:
We are pleased to officially announce that the full version of Retaliation: Enemy Mine has been released!  A huge thank you to all those who participated in Early Access and provided invaluable feedback during the final stages of development.  As promised, online cross-platform multiplayer is now available that allows you to seamlessly engage in matches from desktop, tablet, console, or mobile.  Along with that comes custom avatars, ratings, and even a leaderboard that is accessible through your user profile.  So today’s the day—grab a friend and challenge them to a duel shrouded in fog of war or fight alongside one another and try to outwit the challenging AI in team play. 

If you like turn-based strategy games—or if you’ve been wronged recently—you will love Retaliation! 

See you on the battlefield!
